beliefs: f reverses the input string and inserts a '2' at the middle position [E1, E2]
For even-length reversed strings the '2' goes at index len//2 (e.g. 'dcba' -> 'dc2ba', 'ba' -> 'b2a') [E2]
For odd-length reversed strings the '2' goes after the middle character (e.g. 'olleh' -> 'oll2eh', 'a' -> 'a2') [E1, E2]
Case and punctuation are preserved, only order changes and '2' is inserted [E1]
For length-1 strings the '2' goes after the single character ('a' -> 'a2') [E2]
